title: Impact of Grade Retention on Future Academic Performance
research_question: Does retaining students who score just below a cutoff on end-of-year tests affect their future academic performance negatively? This study aims to determine the causal impact of grade retention on subsequent test scores.
data_description: The dataset includes 400 students with columns for running_var (end-of-year test scores), treated (indicator for retention), and y (future test scores). The data focuses on students near the cutoff score for grade retention.

ground_truth.identification_strategy: The analysis exploits the cutoff in test scores to identify the causal effect.
ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Students retained due to scoring below the cutoff perform worse on future tests.

_fix_notes.description: Ground-truth effect and direction corrected to match actual data. Root cause: extend_exp_b_to_100.py:267 applied abs() before passing effect to make_rdd(), so the synthetic CSV has positive effect while the JSON recorded the original signed value. Data file unchanged; only JSON metadata updated.
